title: The Weight of a Word
text:
Precise vocabulary separates a persuasive argument from a merely emphatic one. A writer who says 'some evidence suggests' makes a narrower claim than one who says 'the evidence proves'. Such qualifiers are not a sign of weakness; they signal intellectual honesty and invite scrutiny. Readers tend to trust a claim more when its limits are clearly stated.

However, excessive hedging can frustrate an audience, which may conclude that the writer lacks conviction. The skill lies in calibrating language so that each word matches the strength of the available evidence. Careful debaters therefore treat every adjective and modal verb as a deliberate commitment rather than a decorative choice.

questions.text: According to the passage, what do qualifiers signal?
options: Intellectual honesty and an invitation to scrutiny
A complete lack of any evidence

questions.text: What can excessive hedging cause an audience to conclude?
options: That the writer has proven every claim
That the evidence is entirely absent
That the text was written in another language

questions.text: Why might readers trust a claim more when its limits are clearly stated?
options: Because stated limits suggest the writer has considered the evidence carefully
Because limits make the claim longer and more complicated
Because readers generally prefer uncertain statements
Because stated limits remove the need for any evidence

questions.text: What does the final sentence imply about careful debaters?
options: They choose each word deliberately to match the strength of their claims
They avoid using adjectives and modal verbs entirely
They rely mainly on decoration in their writing
They never change their wording once it is written

vocabulary.definition: words or phrases that limit or modify the strength of a claim
a firm belief or a strong opinion that is held with confidence
adjusting something precisely so that it matches a required level

paragraph_translations: Kesin sözcük seçimi, ikna edici bir argümanı yalnızca vurgulu bir argümandan ayırır. 'Some evidence suggests' diyen bir yazar, 'the evidence proves' diyen birinden daha dar bir iddiada bulunur. Bu tür niteleyiciler zayıflık işareti değildir; entelektüel dürüstlüğü gösterir ve incelemeye davet eder. Okuyucular, sınırları açıkça belirtilen bir iddiaya genellikle daha çok güvenir.

Ancak aşırı çekingen bir dil izleyiciyi yorabilir; izleyici yazarın inancının zayıf olduğu sonucuna varabilir. Beceri, her sözcüğün elde edilen kanıtın gücüyle uyuşmasını sağlayacak biçimde dili ayarlamakta yatar. Bu yüzden dikkatli münazaracılar her sıfatı ve kip fiilini süslü bir seçim değil, bilinçli bir taahhüt olarak görür.
